1274-3490-4659-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-8319.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

997-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
997-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

465-585-3742-4251-4359.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1322-2034-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

511-817-3062-4050-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

475-2919-4186-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-2919-4186-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

2104-7715-7722.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
2104-7715-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mighty Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

856-4050-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3110-3532-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1251-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1322-2366-5175-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2366-5175-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4740-5147-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4740-5147-5220-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
4740-5147-5220-6900.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1235-1318-2743.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Twinflame twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Twinflame spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

799-1618-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
799-1618-6496--97.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
You have enough mana to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
799-1618-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Karn's Temporal Sundering and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Karn's Temporal Sundering's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
799-1618-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

876-3156-4242-4763.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1018-1799-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding one mana of any color.
When Skullwinder dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Skullwinder from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Skullwinder from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand and causing an opponent to return a card to their hand from their graveyard.
Repeat.
1018-1799-2579-2701-4050.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

751-3821-5334.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}.
751-3821-5334.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Roaming Throne.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Roaming Throne, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

4944-5639.notablePrerequisites: You have one or fewer cards in hand.
4944-5639.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Crackdown Construct.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Arm-Mounted Armor ability, attaching it to Crackdown Construct.
Repeat.

122-1496-1734-5256.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player(s) to mill infinite cards.

1982-3258-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1982-3258-5131.description:
Cast Sidisi from your graveyard by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Sidisi enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sidisi.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

2390-3372-4651.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
2390-3372-4651.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Cast Phyresis by paying {1}{B}, attaching it to All Will Be One.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.

1608-1651-2382-4659.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Triplicate Titan token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Triplicate Titan dies, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Golems, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1651-1737-3129.notablePrerequisites: Any artifact with mana value 0 exiled by Prototype Portal.
1651-1737-3129.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating two token copies of the imprinted artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two artifact tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
